examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The band as the Workloads page places it: the product name as overline, the headline and lead over five feature screens, each with its own illustration and a link out to the documentation. From the large breakpoint up the features run through the sticky stack with the illustration pinned; below it they fall into a three-column grid of media tiles. Edit the props in the Controls panel — a band with no items renders nothing at all.

examples.name: Live scenes
examples.summary: The same band with a live console fragment for each feature: every item names a `ConsoleMockup` as its `scene`, so the pinned stage plays the open step's screen and the small-screen grid shows each one still. An item's `scene` wins over its `illustration`.

examples.name: Code
examples.summary: The band as the Web Apps page places it: five capabilities, from deploying with the CLI to querying metrics over GraphQL, each pinning a one-file `code` sample (`{ fileName, code, language?, fileIcon?, copyAriaLabel? }`) with a docs button under the open step. An item's `scene` wins over its `code`, and `code` over its `illustration`. The GraphQL action opens the docs in a new tab (`target: '_blank'`).
